reviewer_role: Personally read all 239 actual sources in order, necessary target and speaker context, and all 148 original full triples in six untruncated groups. Preserved and reread the original author corrections. After independent peer findings, preserved the frozen 147-row TSV, author receipt and cases; personally reread all seven old complete triples, all six corrected retained complete triples, the two corrected source-only cases and the new source-only deferral, with twelve full surrounding context ranges. All 146 final retained triples and all 95 final deferrals are covered by actual author reading; five candidate triples remain unchanged and were personally read. Sixteen own fresh raw/header book pins remain verified. The peer will record final acceptance separately.
read_binding_note: The original 148 full triples were separately reread. The author self-refinement removed one weak wealth comparison and refined the wine-container comparison. The frozen 147-row pre-peer input was then revised only by the peer’s exact seven recorded row deltas: one weak general-innocence comparison removed and six precise wording refinements. All seven complete old triples and all six complete new triples were personally reread. Of the final146 rows,140 are unchanged from the previously read frozen input; six corrected full triples were separately read. Two source-only reasons were precisely corrected and personally reread, and Job31:5 is newly deferred after its full source, removed target, reason and context were reread.
truncated_read_recovery: No source, target, context, complete-triple, candidate or deferral reading display was truncated. A PowerShell-quoting attempt to construct the pin helper failed before execution and was replaced with an explicit scratch helper. An inventory-key inspection used verses instead of units and failed; the final inventory equality check uses units. Neither failed invocation is counted as reading or verification.
same_chapter_policy: Every same-chapter relationship is explicitly labelled and identifies a question and answer, contrast in knowledge, narrated explanation, pressure and relief, conditional danger and rescue, or repeated plea/deliverance formulation. No source overlaps its target.
textual_precision_notes: Job and the friends, Elihu, the narrator and the Lord remain distinct speakers. The Lord's final rebuke of the three friends is not made an endorsement of Elihu.
The source gives Job 31:35-37 as a written bond returned to a debtor; it is not recast as an accusation against God.
The failed sun and diminished moon, hand-kissing, and ensuing lawlessness in 31:26-28 remain an unresolved proposed celestial-worship comparison.
Job 32:19 explicitly bursts a bellows; Matthew 9:17 explicitly bursts old wineskins. The retained comparison distinguishes these images.
Job 33:4 says the Almighty's breath teaches; it is not silently changed to gives life.
The thousand death-bearing angels in 33:23 are not replaced with an interpreting mediator.
The without-sinning wording in 34:8, first-person vow in 34:10, difficult relative clause in 34:19, placement wording in 34:23 and refusal to take pledges in 34:31 are preserved.
All original source and target references, anchors, text and continuation metadata remain untouched; target ranges are resolved from the actual inventory order.
Job27:9 and35:12-13 compare unheard cries while retaining the difference between the ungodly person and the oppressed criers.
Job20:17 is a wish;30:19 describes the portion without expressly assigning it;32:13 warns against a claim rather than proving it was voiced.
The drinking-mockery comparison at34:7 preserves34:8’s negative wording and does not equate it with drinking injustice. Job34:32 is not rewritten as a statement about what the speaker had not seen.
The30:2 deferral asks about the usefulness of strength without claiming its loss;30:3 retains fled a waterless place instead of importing flight into that place.

deferred_source_units.reason: The prelude introduces Job's continued speech; another introductory formula alone supplies no substantive connection.
The wish for enemies' overthrow is not harmonized with Job's later denial of rejoicing at their fall; the scope of that proposed comparison remains pending.
The announcement of teaching what is in the Lord's hand is a discourse claim, not an identification of a particular revealed message elsewhere.
The survivors' death and unpitied widows are not identified with a particular bereavement or punishment narrative.
Pains like water and nighttime gloom are preserved as this description of the ungodly person's end; a general flood or darkness analogy is insufficient.
The hurling and fleeing retain their supplied pronouns; no particular assailant or historical pursuit is supplied.
Clapping and hissing at removal do not by themselves establish an identity with another derision scene.
The origins and refining place of silver and gold are not identified with a particular mine or refining episode.
Earth's iron and quarried copper do not identify a particular promised land or mining location.
The order for darkness and examination of stone and death's shadow are not simplified into an outside edition's mining description.
The torrent's breach and those forgetting a righteous road have difficult supplied wording; no physical mining procedure is inferred.
Bread from earth and its fiery underside are not treated as a volcanic event or a specific judgment.
The sappheiros and gold location is not equated with another gemstone deposit from shared material names.
The bird and vulture's unknown path are not identified with a particular geographical road.
The untrodden path of arrogant sons and lion is retained without replacing its supplied subjects or making a generic wilderness link.
Breaking river eddies and the speaker's seeing precious things do not establish a particular river crossing or mining technology.
Wisdom's absence among humans is kept in its surrounding contrast with God's knowledge; no unsupported universal denial of all human wisdom is added.
The abyss and sea denying possession are not identified with an underworld journey or sea event.
The supplied term gabis and the instruction concerning innermost things are not replaced with an assumed gemstone or price from another edition.
The repeated location question functions as a refrain; no extra link is retained merely for duplicating the already compared question and answer.
Destruction and Death hearing wisdom's renown are not equated with a particular personal revelation in Hades.
The general statement of God's knowledge of all creation lacks an additional narrowly distinctive target in this pass.
The speech prelude adds no particular relationship beyond marking Job's continuation.
Former weightiness and God's inspection of the house are not expanded into an asserted council meeting or a specific divine visit.
The city squares and Job's chair do not identify a particular civic office or another named city's gate.
Hearers' blessing and tongues clinging to throats are not treated as literal muteness or equated with another incident.
The ear's blessing and eye turning aside are preserved without changing the latter phrase into another edition's testimony.
Being an eye to the blind and foot to the lame is not treated as a report that Job performed a healing miracle.
The crushed molars and recovered plunder are not identified with an unrelated literal assault or animal encounter.
The new glory and bow going in His hand retain their wording; no military victory or particular divine weapon is inferred.
The listeners' joy and adding no further word are a continuation of former reception, with no independent event identity established.
The response to Job's smile and the unfailing light of his face are not expanded into an external account of unbelief or divine favor.
The question about their hands' strength and statement that their completion perished do not assign an age, illness or settled antecedent beyond the supplied pronouns.
The barren need and the people who fled a waterless place yesterday do not identify a specific exile or wilderness migration.
Salt plants and chewed roots describe their hunger; no named famine or edible species identification is supplied.
Thieves rising against Job are not equated with either prologue raid solely because both involve attackers.
Rock holes as houses do not identify these people with another cave-dwelling group.
The supplied resounding things and wild brushwood are not silently converted into a different landscape or animal sound.
The foolish and dishonored lineage is not a genealogical identification of any known people.
The right hand of a shoot and roads of destruction have difficult supplied wording; no standard-edition military reconstruction is imposed.
The poured-out soul and days of pain are retained as lament; a generic additional distress association is insufficient.
The robe and tunic-collar comparison is not identified with literal arrest or a particular garment seizure.
The supplied placement amid pains and casting from salvation is not changed into the wind-riding wording of another edition.
The wish to master himself or ask another is not expanded into a specific requested act absent from this unit.
The boiling belly and days of poverty do not establish a diagnosis or a distinct external calamity.
Groaning and crying in an assembly do not identify a particular public hearing or legal procedure.
The question of God's apportionment introduces the oath's moral setting; no additional inheritance or allotment identity is supplied.

The oath about walking with mockers and hastening toward deceit concerns different acts from the general commitment against lawless speech and unjust thought in Job 27:4. Once those acts are distinguished, the proposed link rests on a broad assertion of innocence rather than a sufficiently particular connection; no pair is retained.
The conditional dislocation and shattered arm remain a self-curse, not a reported injury or an instruction to mutilate oneself.

Job's oath about rejoicing in wealth is not the same particular instruction as the warning against arrogance and hope in uncertain riches. After comparing the complete texts and context, the remaining shared subject of attitudes toward wealth is too broad for this retained link. The source remains pending.
The sun failing and moon diminishing are not replaced with an explicit act of worship; the proposed celestial-worship comparison remains uncertain.
Secret deception and kissing the hand may invite a celestial-worship comparison, but that precise interpretation is not secured by the supplied sequence.
The greatest-lawlessness and lying-before-God statement does not settle the uncertain action addressed in the preceding solar and hand-kissing clauses.
The conditional curse and becoming a repeated tale are not treated as an actual confession of rejoicing at an enemy's fall.
The servants' wish to be filled with his flesh and the explanation of exceptional kindness are preserved without turning them into a conventional feeding claim.
The supplied written bond is not an indictment against God; its opening question and fear clause do not establish a separate legal-document identity.
Wearing and reading the bond as a crown remain within the debtor sequence; no outside edition's adversary-authored accusation is imported.
The earth and furrows' complaint is not made a literal environmental event or equated with another land's curse.
The renewed anger over the friends' lack of answer repeats the narrated grounds; no additional generic anger comparison is retained.
Elihu's explanation of age and prior silence supplies context to the retained narrator-to-speech comparison, without a reciprocal pair merely repeating it.
The request to listen and announcement of knowledge is not by itself a particular teaching parallel.
The listening and examination instruction is part of Elihu's introduction; no extra link rests on a common imperative to hear.
The asserted lack of a refutation remains Elihu's judgment of the debate, not an additional proof that all his arguments are endorsed.
Allowing a human to speak such words is not replaced with another edition's claim about whether Job addressed Elihu personally.
The terrified silence and exhausted words do not identify a separate episode or establish a medical inability to speak.
Elihu's continued waiting repeats the debate setting without an independently specific additional target.
The reply formula adds no substantive comparison beyond identifying Elihu's speech.
The intention to speak for rest is already context for the retained pressure-and-relief comparison; no reverse duplicate is added.
The address to Job and request to hear are not linked to unrelated commands to listen.
Opening the mouth and speaking are introductory actions, not a distinctive external event.
Elihu's statement that he heard Job introduces the following reports; it does not itself identify another hearing incident.
The uncovering of minds through fear is not equated with a specific dream interpretation or with the literal opening of eyes.
Rescue from death and falling in war are not assigned to a named battle or individual beyond the illustrative human.
The thousand death-bearing angels and one not wounding him are not replaced with an interpreter or mediator; the proposed Balaam comparison remains uncertain.
The three ways are retained without inventing an explicit numbered list or treating the statement as three counted lifetime rescues.
The request for silence continues Elihu's speech and does not identify a distinct rebuke elsewhere.
Elihu's promise to teach wisdom is not treated as proof that every statement in his speech is divinely endorsed.
The reply formula identifies Elihu but supplies no substantive target relationship.
The address to wise hearers is not equated with a named council or an unrelated wisdom instruction.
Choosing judgment together is an exhortation within this debate, not an established legal procedure elsewhere.
The supplied text says without sinning or acting ungodly; it is not silently reversed into a positive accusation of walking with evildoers.
The supplied first-person vow may I never act ungodly is not replaced with the different proposition that God never does evil.
The broad affirmation of the Maker of earth and heaven lacks a further narrowly distinctive target retained in this pass.
The renewed request to hear does not supply an additional particular connection.
The general description of the eternally righteous One destroying wickedness is not tied to a specific judgment event.
The sentence following the criticism of speech against rulers has a difficult referent; divine impartiality is not assumed against its actual wording.
He will place no more upon a man is preserved rather than replaced with a claim that further examination is unnecessary.
Making works known and turning night about are not identified with a named historical overthrow.
Extinguishing the ungodly while they are visible does not identify a particular destruction narrative.
Turning from God's law and ordinances is a general description here, with no particular statute or incident established.
Quiet, concealment of the face, and inability to condemn or see are not combined into a particular national event or settled referent beyond the text.
The supplied refusal to take pledges is not replaced with a different confession of punishment or conventional pledge-law application.
The question about repayment on the hearer's terms is not expanded into a doctrine of choosing punishment or a separate legal demand.
Elihu's appeal to what the wise will say introduces the following accusation; it is not independent corroboration of that accusation.
The exhortation to learn rather than answer like the foolish remains Elihu's rebuke; a generic fool or instruction comparison is insufficient.
